Question: When Dave walks to school, he averages \(90\) steps per minute, each of his steps \(75\) cm long. It takes him \(16\) minutes to get to school. His brother, Jack, going to the same school by the same route, averages \(100\) steps per minute, but his steps are only \(60\) cm long. How long does it take Jack to get to school?
